value.rationale: The result establishes a sharp natural lossless-reconstruction spacing threshold for a fixed simple local observation, uniformly across all stable ring sizes, and identifies exact structured defects below threshold: two isolated double fibers at intermediate exclusions versus an exponentially large double-fiber census and one triple fiber at the weakest exclusion. The theorem is an all-parameter structural and inverse-coding classification with explicit extremizers, not a small finite table or a renamed full-shift kernel.
